purpose: Every binary revision whose enumeration, responder, restart and failed-atomic-replace cleanup paths must be proven unable to enumerate, serve or delete system-record V1 reserved state. CI executes every entry and reports a per-entry result in managed-ownership-verdict.json. Changing supported predecessors requires reviewing a diff of this file; a moving branch head or a new-binary-only filter is explicitly insufficient.

oxigraph.note: The gate resolves the platform asset and its pinned SHA-256 from the production constant rather than restating it, so a version bump cannot silently desynchronise this manifest from the binary actually launched.

entries.description: Stack A merged into testnet-canary. Predates every system-record storage path; its enumeration filter is the pre-existing prefix-wide isAtomicGraphReplaceStagingGraph.
Stack B1 (#2103) core protocol codecs. Adds no storage path; reserved state must remain invisible for exactly the same reason as Stack A.
Shipped release line operators are running today. This is the entry that proves the downgrade property for real deployments rather than only for branch heads.

reserved-state-fixture-v1.description: Seeded directly into a live Oxigraph v0.5.8 store so a predecessor observes state it has no code for. Quad counts are pinned so a silent partial seed fails the gate instead of passing it.
